生成された動画：=== REFERENCES ===

Use the provided Riven, Ally Soldier, SOLDIERS,
ROAD TO HOME VILLAGE, HOME/VILLAGE,
and provided battle final-frame references.

Keep the same character identities, faces, costumes, weapons,
and environment throughout the entire video.

Riven uses the exact same sword shown in the Riven reference.

Ally Soldier uses the exact same weapon and equipment shown
in the Ally Soldier reference.

The provided battle final-frame reference establishes the current situation:

Riven and Ally Soldier are already fighting together inside a large
circle of SOLDIERS on the mountain road.

Use this image only to understand the current situation and continuity.

Do not recreate its exact camera composition or exact soldier positions.

The HOME/VILLAGE reference represents Riven's home far away
along the mountain valley.

Do not move the action into the village.


=== TECHNICAL ===

16:9 cinematic live-action dark fantasy.

Late sunset.

Grounded cinematic sword combat.

Natural physical movement.

Natural English dialogue and lip sync.

Natural cinematic cuts and camera movement.

Keep every action simple, sequential, and visually readable.

Do not create unnecessary camera cuts.

All ordinary SOLDIERS belong to the same army.

Riven and Ally Soldier are their only targets.

SOLDIERS never attack other SOLDIERS.

Riven and Ally Soldier never attack each other.

Riven is already physically exhausted from prolonged fighting.

The sacrifice must happen as a sudden last-second reaction.

The essential action order is:

THE ARCHER FIRES.
THE ARROW IS ALREADY FLYING TOWARD RIVEN.
ONLY THEN DOES ALLY NOTICE IT.
ALLY SHOUTS "RIVEN!"
THE ARROW CONTINUES TOWARD RIVEN.
ALLY THROWS HIS OWN BODY INTO ITS PATH.
THE ARROW HITS ALLY INSTEAD.

No graphic gore.

No subtitles.

No background music.


=== VIDEO SUMMARY ===

Riven and Ally Soldier are fighting together while surrounded
by SOLDIERS on the mountain road.

Riven is exhausted from the prolonged battle.

During the fight, a distant archer finds a clear opening toward Riven.

The archer fires.

The arrow is already flying rapidly toward Riven
when Ally suddenly notices it.

Ally realizes Riven does not see the danger.

He shouts her name.

The arrow continues directly toward Riven.

At the last possible moment, Ally throws his entire body
into the arrow's path.

The arrow strikes Ally instead.

Riven catches him as he collapses.

Ally dies in Riven's arms.

While grieving over him, Riven notices enormous columns of dark smoke
rising far across the valley from the direction of her home village.

She realizes that something terrible is happening there.

But Riven does not immediately leave Ally.

Still devastated, she looks back down at him.

She slowly and carefully lowers his body onto the ground.

End on Riven remaining beside Ally.


=== SCENES ===

Shot 1 — FIGHTING TOGETHER

Begin with a closer medium combat angle.

Do not recreate the exact wide composition shown in the provided
battle final-frame reference.

Riven and Ally Soldier are already fighting together inside
the surrounding army.

Keep many SOLDIERS visible around them.

Every SOLDIER attack is directed toward Riven or Ally.

The SOLDIERS never attack each other.

Riven and Ally protect each other's blind sides.

Riven is visibly exhausted.

Her breathing is heavy.

Her movements remain skilled but are becoming slower.

Ally stays close to her while they continue fighting.

Keep this combat section brief and simple.

Its only purpose is to establish that Riven and Ally
are still fighting together.


Shot 2 — THE ARROW AND THE SACRIFICE

During the fighting, a distant SOLDIER with a military bow
finds a clear opening toward Riven.

Riven is occupied fighting another SOLDIER.

Ally is also occupied nearby.

Neither Riven nor Ally notices the archer.

The archer raises the bow.

He aims directly at Riven.

He releases the bowstring.


The arrow leaves the bow and flies rapidly toward Riven.

Clearly establish that the arrow has ALREADY BEEN FIRED.

It is already traveling through the battlefield toward Riven.

Riven does not see it.


Only now does Ally notice the flying arrow.

This is the first moment Ally becomes aware of the danger.

Ally sees the arrow already moving through the air.

He immediately realizes where it is going.

Riven is directly in its path.


Ally urgently shouts:

"RIVEN!"


Riven hears him and begins to react.

But the arrow is already too close.

The arrow continues directly toward Riven.


Ally reacts instantly.

He does not try to block the arrow with his weapon.

He does not push Riven away.

He does not calmly move in front of her.


Ally throws his entire body toward Riven.

He desperately launches himself directly across
the path of the already-flying arrow.


The visual action must remain extremely simple and clear:

The arrow is flying toward Riven.

Ally sees it.

Ally shouts her name.

The arrow keeps flying toward Riven.

Ally throws his own body into its path.


At the final possible moment,
Ally's body crosses directly between the arrow and Riven.


The arrow strikes Ally instead of Riven.


The impact is sudden.

Riven remains unharmed directly behind him.

Ally loses his strength immediately.

Riven catches him before he falls completely.


Shot 3 — ALLY'S LAST MOMENT

Stay close to Riven and Ally.

Do not introduce unnecessary camera changes.

Riven supports Ally in her arms as they lower toward the ground.

The surrounding battle becomes visually secondary.

Riven looks at Ally in shock.

She realizes that he deliberately took the arrow meant for her.


Riven quietly asks:

"Why?"


Ally is badly weakened.

He looks at her.

He answers softly:

"You would've done the same."


A brief silence.

Ally loses his remaining strength.

His body becomes still.

Riven realizes he is gone.


Riven continues holding him.

She does not immediately move.

Her expression is devastated.

Allow a quiet emotional moment between them.


Shot 4 — THE DISTANT FIRE

While Riven is still holding Ally,
something far across the valley catches her attention.

Riven slowly raises her head.

Her attention shifts toward the distant horizon.


Follow her gaze toward the mountain valley.

Far away, in the direction of her home village,
several enormous columns of thick dark smoke rise high
into the late-sunset sky.

A distant orange fire glow is visible beneath the smoke.

The smoke clearly comes from the direction of Riven's home.

Keep everything very far away.

Do not move into the village.

Do not reveal detailed destruction.

Only establish the distant smoke and fire.


Return the emotional focus to Riven.

She stares toward the smoke.

Her grief is joined by sudden fear and realization.

She understands that something terrible is happening
at her home village.


But Riven does NOT run away yet.

She does NOT immediately stand up.

She does NOT leave Ally.


After looking toward the distant smoke,
Riven slowly lowers her gaze back toward Ally in her arms.

The urgency of the distant fire remains,
but for this moment she cannot bring herself to leave him.


Riven looks at Ally's face again.

Her expression remains deeply grief-stricken.

She holds him for one final quiet moment.


Then Riven slowly and carefully lowers Ally's body
onto the ground.

She supports his head and shoulders as she lays him down gently.

The movement is slow and respectful.

Riven remains kneeling beside him.


End with Riven beside Ally's body,
still devastated by his death,
with the distant smoke from her home visible beyond the battlefield.

She has not left yet.

CUT.、16:9
